subject: HLTH
course_description: It is increasingly evident that individual involvement in personal health has profound benefits. This course provides students the opportunity to become involved in a personalized approach to health and well-being with strategic approaches for the implementation of a healthy lifestyle.
course_notes: Monday Only Classes: Wednesday, December 9, 2026, will serve as the designated class meeting day for all Fall 2026 courses that are regularly scheduled to meet only on Mondays. If you have any questions, please contact the Office of Undergraduate Education.
